summary.intent: Drive caliper toward a v1 alpha by executing a six-trail plan (comparison oracle, perf, detection, release flow, etc.) using parallel isolated-worktree workers, then make the checker-default extract at least 2-3x faster than react-docgen-typescript.
summary.outcome: Created trails #153-#158 and opened stacked draft PRs for the oracle (#280/#281) and weekly pairing (#282/#283) work. Also diagnosed a release race (E148), made the checker the default (#441) and moved the weekly onto it (#442), and addressed the #440 finding. The release-flow worker (trail 158) is still running, the trail 154 perf branches are built but unpushed, and the checker-extract speed worker restarted after an API failure and is still finishing, so the 2-3x bar is unproven.

repo: Entire flow: push a branch, then `entire trail link N --branch B --base BASE`; Entire auto-opens the PR, and the title and body must be edited afterward while keeping the Entire marker. Stacked branches must be linked with the parent as `--base` before any PR exists.

Callisto 0.16.0 can attach GitHub Release assets with build attestations, but it verifies a signer workflow named `callisto-release.yml`, so `release.yml` would need renaming. This is read from the spec only, not confirmed in source.

Callisto release-flow constraints: the npm bin cannot be an artifact product (E304), so the product package must be `cargo/caliper-docgen`; `forge-repository` must equal origin (E187); recovery runs only on push to main and workflow_dispatch, not on a schedule.
The E148 release failure is a stale PR snapshot race in the version-pr step. Re-running the job or the next push fixes it, and Callisto does not recommend a retry.
Homebrew tap reads the tag `npm/caliper-docgen@x.y.z`, so tag-template must stay unset to keep tag names unchanged.

The checker is now the default (ADR 0026 S8). `--no-checker` selects the structural resolver, and `PipelineOptions::experimental_semantic_types` is renamed `checker`. The Vite plugin passes `checker: false`, and `watch` stays structural.

Checker-default cost: gate-large (938 components) takes about 6 s and about 970 MiB, versus about 0.1 s and 200 MiB with `--no-checker`. RDT takes about 10 s on the benchmark project, so no checker-versus-RDT ratio is measured yet.

Weekly corpus budgets in `scripts/headline.py` BUDGETS are `None` (record on first run). After two scheduled runs, set time to 1.5x and memory to 1.25x the larger run, rounded up. `UNIVERSE_VERSION` was bumped to 5 to avoid a false wrong-rate issue.

Oracle and weekly: react-docgen follows imports via fsImporter, and the old 'reads each file alone' docs claim is wrong. It throws on 17-21% of files. `weekly.py` gains `reference_version` 2, and recall is skipped when versions differ.

antd recall after pairing fixes is 92.1% (186/202), not the ~95% target. The remaining 16 unpaired items are factories, compound members and trail 156 work. A key-collisions branch was skipped because Caliper emits two components under one normalized key.

In the sandbox, `tsx` fails on its IPC socket (EPERM), so run `node src/oracle.ts` directly, since Node 26 strips types. Brain's `brief` also failed on a write-lock denial under `~/.local/share/entire/`.

code.finding: A refused createSnapshot/updateSnapshot now calls `discard()`, releasing the snapshot the discarded answer created. Previously the snapshot ID was lost and leaked until the memory bound disabled the checker (fixed in 10df5137, with a sibling fix at line 446).
`AnswerCache::shared` shares one copy of identical props across checker answers in a session. This fixed about 6.7 MiB per component growth that would have caused an OOM on the Storybook path.

workflow: Subagent worktrees can't write to the shared tmp dir in the sandbox; use `$TMPDIR`.
Subagents should push with the remote SHA verified (`git ls-remote`) before finishing, so work survives a crash or restart.
Agents restarted after a stop or API error resume from a saved transcript and may redo steps, so check the worktree state first.
Entire's classifier blocks `entire trail finding resolve` as an external write, so a finding may have to be resolved by the user or by Entire's re-evaluation.
Local machine load (9-21) makes timings noisy, so compare only interleaved side-by-side runs.

friction: Brain brief failed on a sandbox write-lock denial and was never retried outside the sandbox.
The callisto-gap report was truncated and had to be re-requested.
An accidental `/stop` hit the speed worker, and an API DNS error then killed it and left uncommitted work.
The local Callisto is too old for the repo's `callisto.toml`, so `callisto status --check` could not run.
The five weekly corpora (mantine, chakra, shadcn, antd, spectrum) are not installed locally, so many results are unvalidated.
The trail 154 perf branches only reached about -6% time and -5% RSS, short of the baseline, because the machine was too loaded to measure cleanly.
The #440 finding still shows open in Entire despite the fix being pushed.
open_items: Speed worker on `perf/checker-extract-speed`: commit and push, prove byte-identical output, re-measure RDT vs checker, and verify the watch and first-answer numbers do not regress. The 2-3x faster-than-RDT bar is unproven.

Trail 158 release flow (three stacked branches) is in progress. Decisions for the user: rename `release.yml` to `callisto-release.yml`, add an E148 retry, and check the Homebrew tap's tag use. All of it is untested without a real release.
Trail 154 branches (`perf/project-demands-sort`, `perf/module-demands-lean`) are unpushed, and the `perf/cache-react-augmentations` branch was deleted.

Trail 153: `oracle/three-tools-report` waits on #280-#283 merging. Spectrum's 1.09% oracle wrong-rate is uninvestigated, and Mantine, Chakra and Spectrum need a CI weekly run to validate the new rules.
Trails 155 and 156 (detection stack) and trail 157 branches are not started.

Merge order #440, then #441 (with #442 included), then slice 4 (delete the process route, `crates/tsc-client` and the `typescript@beta` fallback), then a single oracle run and reword the speed headline.
Storybook live-upgrade worker (push checker answers into an open story, wider prefetch) is awaiting the user's go and #441 merging.
Set weekly corpus budgets after two scheduled checker runs. A real Storybook run with the checker default is unverified.
Resolve finding 01M778W5HQ7T in Entire, and close or ignore PR #434.
